name: France, presidential election 2022, runoff
summary: Retrospective replay from the ministry's own results page (12 archived versions, national totals with the real times) with settings taken from the earlier 2017 nights. No market price history exists for this night, so the model is shown alone. Its 90% range for the main question held in 100% of the 8 versions from 1% to 95% counted.
